key_findings: Mitochondrial transplantation into L5 DRG alleviated SNL-induced mechanical and thermal hypersensitivity in rats.
MT reduced spinal TNF, IL-1β, IL-6, gliosis and apoptotic markers, and reversed capsaicin-induced cytokine release and apoptosis in DRG neurons.
